facts.fact: The Direção Nacional da Educação began national training on 15 July 2025 for inclusive-education team coordinators and the SIGE focal points of the municipalities on a new SIGE module for assessing children with special educational needs, built by the firm Devtrust.
The national director of education named UNICEF as strategic partner and main funder of the new SIGE special-needs assessment module, giving technical and financial support (15 July 2025).

systems.owner: Direção Nacional da Educação, Ministério da Educação
systems.tiers: SIGE focal points in every municipality; multidisciplinary inclusive-education support teams (EMAEI) enter assessments of children with special needs
